finding.claim: Troubleshooting still points readers to a hyphenated command

findings.claim: The trigger gate can pass a repo-local phrase that autoplan cannot resolve
findings.evidence: check_skill_trigger_resolution resolves phrases against src/claude/skills, the catalog autoplan's default invocation reads; it still enumerates all 121 skills from .claude/skills. TestAutoplanCatalog fails with the fallback removed (mutation-checked).
findings.fix: use the same catalog in checkout routing and validation.
findings.repro: "prove an ai-agents PR is complete" selects repository-completion-proof with the gate's .claude/skills root and returns none using autoplan's default invocation

findings.claim: Moving an inherited parser error by one line blocks a skillopt candidate
findings.evidence: added_failures strips 'line N' from messages before comparing (_unplaced); test_moving_an_inherited_parse_error_is_not_an_added_failure.
findings.fix: compare parser diagnostics without their source line numbers.
findings.repro: insert a comment above an existing metadata: {outputs: {note: null}} line; new_failures returns fm.subset-parse because the diagnostic moved from line 3 to line 4

findings.claim: Narrowing the ADR intent broke spelled-out amendment requests
findings.evidence: adr-generator gains amend and supersede architecture decision record intents; fixture lt-adr-generator-spelled-out-amend; review-only negatives still route none.
findings.repro: "Amend this architecture decision record" and "Supersede this architecture decision record" return none

overlap_rule: same file and line within 3 of a critic path:line or range
